logos.r2-01: Round 1's 01 with the gap opened up — two halves, not a split ring.
logos.r2-02: Same arcs, gaps moved to top and bottom. Taller, more contained.
logos.r2-03: Three nested arcs, three teals — reach and growth. Stacked lockup.
logos.r2-04: Hairline arcs, light type, wide tracking. The quietest, most premium read.
logos.r2-05: Closed ring notched top and bottom — one object made of two halves.
logos.r2-06: Arcs offset, not yet aligned — sync as something happening. Heaviest voice.
logos.r2-07: Arcs closed into a lens. Tightest, most solid shape of the round.
logos.r2-08: Dome over bowl — nested rather than facing. Navy outer, bright teal inner.
logos.r2-09: Arcs plus a centre dot — names the point where the two meet.
logos.r2-10: 01's arcs knocked out of a solid teal squircle. App icon with no extra work.
